summary: PLAT-103: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0). core-shell passes owner 'platform', billing 'payments' (from package.json team). Also fixed sub-route-reports (owner 'insights'), which calls validateApp but was not in the ticket and would have broken on its next build. Shipped as one PR (#1) since libs/shared-contracts is inlined at build time, not a registry package, so no separate release/dependency bump applies. Merged, CI and CD green. PLAT-103-4: libs-platform-kit has no validateApp call and no dependency on shared-contracts, so no change made (assumption: ticket premise is mistaken); no PR opened.
